name: Miracle Twins: Koi no Mahou o Anata ni
original_name: みらくるツインズ 恋の魔法を貴方に
source:
A town engulfed in evil atmosphere. But in the midst of it is a guardian angel girl who protects the town. She is a usual girl who found a magical item to turn into a warrior of justice. For that reason she is targeted by evil forces. Together with main character and another girl able for transformation they fight for the peace of this town.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一座城镇笼罩在邪恶的氛围中。然而，这里也有一位守护天使般的少女，保护着城镇。她原本只是普通女孩，却因为找到了一件魔法道具，能够变身为正义战士，也因此成了邪恶势力的目标。她与主人公，以及另一名拥有变身能力的女孩携手，为守护这座城镇的和平而战。

[据[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]整理]
